**Zions Bancorporation (ZION) 3Q26: Clean Core Growth, Near-Zero NCOs, and Strong 1-Year NII Outlook**

**Headline & EPS Drivers:** Discussing **reported** GAAP diluted EPS (no 3Q26 adjusted EPS disclosed), ZION earned $1.78 in 3Q26, down $1.27 from 2Q26 ($3.05) but up 20% YoY [B0011, B0012, B0035]. The sequential drop is purely optical: 2Q26 included $1.31 per share of notable securities gains ($1.12 from Visa share sales and $0.19 from SBIC valuation gains) [B0758], whereas 3Q26 included a modest +$0.05 net CVA gain ($10 million pre-tax) [B0033, B0758]. Excluding 2Q26's notable gains ($1.74 base), 3Q26 EPS rose $0.04 QoQ [B0756], supported by a $6 million (+2% QoQ) rise in adjusted PPNR to $338 million and an $11 million favorable swing in credit provision to a $(8) million benefit [B0140, B0760].

**Revenue & Margin:** GAAP NII rose $7 million (+1% QoQ) to $684 million ($696 million TE) as average loans grew 3.7% annualized to $62.4 billion and average customer deposits jumped 8.8% annualized to $74.0 billion (total average deposits $78.0 billion) [B0059, B0241, B0590, B0756]. However, FTE NIM compressed 4 bps QoQ to 3.23% as total deposit costs rose 11 bps to 1.59% (including ~3 bps from a derivative collateral reclassification) and excess deposit liquidity was parked in lower-yielding money market investments [B0063, B0064, B0068, B0770]. Reported noninterest income fell $263 million QoQ to $197 million on the absence of 2Q26's $269 million securities gains [B0085, B0087]; adjusted customer-related noninterest income (ex-CVA) edged up $1 million QoQ (+5% YoY) to $182 million [B0088]. Noninterest expense was well contained at $553 million (+$2 million QoQ; adjusted $549 million, +$3 million), improving the efficiency ratio 30 bps QoQ to 61.9% [B0106, B0107, B0111].

**Credit:** Credit was a standout. NCOs were just $3 million, or 0.02% annualized (-4 bps QoQ, -35 bps YoY), driving an $8 million provision release [B0140, B0142, B0147]. Classified loans fell $204 million (-9% QoQ) to $2,123 million (3.40%), while NPAs edged up $17 million to $315 million (0.50%); ACL/loans eased 2 bps to 1.11% [B0143-B0149].

**Capital & Returns:** ROTCE was 16.2% (vs. ~17.1% ex-gains in 2Q26) [B0014, B0670]. CET1 held steady at a robust 11.8% after $75 million in buybacks and a dividend hike to $0.48 [B0187, B0193, B0271], while TBVPS dipped to $43.50 on $229 million of goodwill/intangibles from the Basis Multifamily Finance acquisition and $122 million of AOCI widening [B0031, B0195, B0196].

**Guidance & Thesis:** ZION's 3Q27E vs. 3Q26A outlook projects strong 8%–12% NII growth, 6%–9% adjusted customer fee growth, 2%–4% loan growth, and 4%–6% adjusted expense growth (positive operating leverage) [B0788]. Asset sensitivity, deposit momentum, and pristine credit reinforce a constructive thesis.
